نتناسخ (form VI)

# نَتَنَاسَخَ (natanāsaḵa) /na.ta.naː.sa.xa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاسَخَ (tanāsaḵa)
# نَتَنَاسَخْ (natanāsaḵ) /na.ta.naː.sax/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاسَخَ (tanāsaḵa)
